testPlan.title: Smooth rebuild follows the picked span

test.title: The game loaded this test version
test.hint: Load Welker Farms, savegame 3. This ticks by itself.

test.title: Pick a span along the loop
test.hint: Smooth tool, mode rebuild. Pick a span along the spline loop at the end of the two-lane road, where it went wrong before. PASS when the preview shows it.

test.title: Apply the rebuild
test.hint: Right-click to apply. This ticks by itself.

test.title: Only the picked span changed
test.hint: The new points lie where the preview was. The other side of the loop is as it was. PASS if so.

test.title: Undo puts it back
test.hint: Press Q (undo). The loop is back as it was. PASS if so.
